title: Cosmic Crystal Sorcerer
description: A futuristic armored figure stands in a circular futuristic chamber, wearing a sleek black, blue, and magenta crystalline suit with a glowing white visor. The figure casts glowing magical energy from both hands while surrounded by floating white doves, sparkling crystal shards, and swirling golden ribbons.
prompt: A humanoid figure in sleek futuristic armor composed of black, electric blue, and magenta crystalline panels stands inside a circular high-tech chamber. The armor has sharp geometric facets and glowing white eyes. The figure is dynamically posed with both hands extended, casting swirling trails of white sparkles, golden energy ribbons, and floating pink crystal shards. White doves fly around the figure. The background shows a cosmic sky with crescent moons in black, blue, and pink, with stars and nebulae visible through a broken dome ceiling.
